To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a framework for multidimensional analysis of XML documents with OLAP dimensions.
• A multidimensional analysis framework for textual data is presented.

1) XML documents are a new source of information for data warehouses and OLAP systems, 2) the multidimensional analysis can be extended to XML documents and, 3) the multidimensional model is a good framework for the analysis of textual documents in a data warehouse.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: how to define a multidimensional schema that is suitable for the analysis of documents, how to build this schema, and how to use it for the analysis of document contents.

the following issues: - The definition of a multidimensional schema for the multidimensional exploration of XML documents; - The definition of multidimensional operators to navigate through the multidimensional schema; - The implementation of a multidimensional OLAP system for the multidimensional exploitation of XML documents.
the design and implementation of a multidimensional analysis of XML document contents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed framework allows for the multidimensional representation of textual documents in order to perform OLAP analysis.
the proposed approach provides a framework to perform a multidimensional analysis of XML document collections.
XML documents are not only a data source, but they can also be considered as an analysis subject.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an approach that allows users to analyse XML documents with a multidimensional approach, using the OLAP paradigm.
we propose a multidimensional analysis of documents, which is based on a conceptual multidimensional schema that is adapted to textual data.
the proposed framework allows a user to express queries in terms of the concepts he wants to analyse and the relationships between those concepts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have proposed a multidimensional analysis approach for textual data.
the multidimensional model is a good candidate to be used for the analysis of XML documents.
the OLAP technology can be used to perform analysis over documents in an efficient way.
